derivation: Each fixed-bundle confirmation uses one-sided alpha=0.05/8=0.00625 (two-sided bootstrap alpha=0.0125). The union bound over at most 8 submissions is 0.05, without an additional point-effect floor. Independence between submissions is not required; valid intervals and prospective selection are required.
notes: The zero floor follows from allocating the error budget directly to confirmation intervals, not fitting a threshold to observed gains.
The annual bound is nominal and conditional on interval calibration, retraining-noise assumptions, prospective selection and complete accounting.
Exploratory feature checks are not production submissions.
No refunds or ledger resets; historical verdicts remain unchanged.
